comment: UE4SS build bundled into the -with-UE4SS release. This exact file was tested with Queens Domain 1.01.00 (build 13464). Upstream's 'experimental-latest' release is rolling and stopped serving it on 2026-11-01, so an unmodified copy (MIT licence) is kept in this repository's pre-release 'ue4ss-e84db30c'. To move to a newer UE4SS: test it in game, upload it the same way, then update file, url and sha256 here.
